ChargeOut.title: ChargeOut
ChargeOut.description:
One line of a trade's costs. Also the shape stored on the order, so what is saved is
exactly what is served.

HoldingOut.title: HoldingOut
HoldingOut.description: Open trades of one symbol and direction, pooled. Computed, never stored.

MetricRangeOut.title: MetricRangeOut
MetricRangeOut.description: A sector's usual band for an equity metric; for a coin's 52-week position, the year's low and high.

OmittedMetricOut.title: OmittedMetricOut
OmittedMetricOut.description: A metric left out on purpose, with why. Metrics that merely have no figure are not listed.

OrderLegOut.title: OrderLegOut
OrderLegOut.description:
What one leg of an order did. Also the shape stored on the order, so what is saved is
exactly what is served.

OrderPreviewOut.title: OrderPreviewOut
OrderPreviewOut.description: What an order would cost, from the same calculation that charges it.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA zone of the exchange, so times can be shown on its clock.

PayoutOut.title: PayoutOut
PayoutOut.description:
One closed trade, start to finish. Every figure comes from the orders' immutable legs (and
the trade's accumulated exit totals), never from the fields that shrink as a trade is exited.

ProtectionOutcomeOut.title: ProtectionOutcomeOut
ProtectionOutcomeOut.description: What closing the trade's open part at `price` would leave you with, after every charge.

ProtectionPreviewOut.title: ProtectionPreviewOut
ProtectionPreviewOut.description: Checks a stop-loss and target and shows what each would leave you with. Saves nothing.

ShortRuleOut.title: ShortRuleOut
ShortRuleOut.description: How shorting works on a market, for the ticket to explain it. Absent where it isn't offered.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA zone of the exchange, so times can be shown on its clock.
